description: Build CSS background patterns — dots, stripes, checker, zigzag and grid — with your colors and size, live preview, and copyable CSS.

faqs.a: The patterns are built from layered CSS gradients, so they tile perfectly and stay sharp at any zoom.
faqs.q: Are the patterns seamless and sharp?

faqs.a: Yes — the snippet is just a background declaration you can layer over or under other backgrounds.
faqs.q: Can I combine a pattern with a gradient?

faqs.a: Copy the snippet again with a different size or color and apply it to another element, or use multiple background layers.
faqs.q: How do I use two patterns together?

howto: Pick a pattern type (dots, stripes, checker, zigzag, grid).
Choose the foreground and background colors plus tile size.
Click "Copy CSS" and paste it into your stylesheet.
title: CSS Pattern Generator
